summary: Completed comprehensive testing of all new features for Uganda High Commission National ID Services. All key features from the review request are working perfectly. Backend and frontend integration working flawlessly.

minor_issues.issue: Does not require authentication - allows unauthorized access to admin statistics
minor_issues.impact: Information disclosure of appointment statistics (same issue from previous iteration)

passed_tests: Landing page displays 'National ID Services' title correctly
Admin Portal button positioned at top right of hero section
5 services displayed with different colored icons (blue, emerald, violet, amber, rose)
Card Pick-up service present with correct title and rose-colored icon
Phone validation accepts both UK (+44) and Uganda (+256) numbers
Name validation rejects invalid characters (numbers, special chars)
Card Pick-up service shows NIN/Application Number input field when selected
Card Pick-up validation requires NIN - fails without NIN, succeeds with NIN
Confirmation page shows updated important notice with pre-registration ID info
Download button displays 'Download Appointment Confirmation Letter'
Download button is clickable and functional
Mobile responsive design works properly on 390x844 viewport
Admin portal accessible at /admin with working login form
Admin login successful with provided credentials (admin/admin123)
Admin dashboard displays appointments including Card Pick-up services
Backend API supports Card Pick-up service with NIN validation
Backend phone regex accepts Uganda (+256) format correctly
Backend returns proper error messages for validation failures
Complete end-to-end booking flow from landing page to confirmation
Uganda phone numbers display correctly on confirmation page

action_item_for_main_agent.issue: Add authentication requirement to admin stats endpoint
action_item_for_main_agent.details: Admin stats endpoint (/api/admin/stats) should verify JWT token before returning data - same security issue from previous iteration remains unfixed
